messages:
anita: Quick status — OptKit delivery: targeting alpha cut tomorrow EOD. Main open items: quant recommendations for redwood/rdw-small v1.4, batching policy tuning (latency vs cost), and a cache warmup bug on long sequences. Ping owners/pls update.

sam: I can take quant recs. I'll push a draft quant table by noon. Anyone with perf numbers for 2k seqs?

mike: I have perf traces for 2k on A100. Passing to @sam now: https://internal.corp/perf/trace/342 

leo: FYI runtime PR that changes KV eviction landed in draft: https://github.com/redwood/rt/pull/4523 — this is a dependency for cache warmup fix. Need review from eng-runtime.

sam: acknowledged. I'll wait to rebase until #4523 merges. If reviewers needed ping me.

eva: regression alert — small sample of customer prompts showed token-level perf drop after quant. Not widespread but flagged by QA. Details in the eval harness: notebook link (internal).

anita: Thanks. @mike can you run the reg test with the draft quant profile (q8f) and report delta? If >2% cost/latency regress we'll gate.

mike: running now, attaching quick logs: ```2026-03-16T18:02Z INFO batch_size=8 latency_p95=98ms latency_p99=210ms tokens=2048``` will post full numbers in a bit.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for optkit-alpha -> canary-1 at 2026-03-17T02:00Z :rocket:

leo: Ownership: quant recs -> sam, batch/cost policy -> mike, cache warmup -> eng-runtime (leo). Can we sync on PR owners by EOD?

sam: noted. I'll add reviewers and tag @ml-evals. Also adding a small test to the harness for the specific prompt set.

anita: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, add to this thread and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
